nodes.label: Dual test/live credit balance tracking on tenant wallets
tenant_credit_wallets (per-tenant prepaid credit wallet)
Rationale: credit functions are CREATE OR REPLACE applied via apply_migration, not tracked in this file
Bonzah insurance policy chaining for long rentals
Rationale: Bonzah caps a single policy at 30 days, so a longer rental needs sequential policies sharing one chain_id
bonzah_insurance_policies (issued insurance cover per rental)
Per-tenant Twilio subaccount and phone number provisioning
tenants (tenant configuration and integration credentials)
Messaging provider secrets (Twilio auth token, Meta access token) live as plain tenant columns
Per-tenant Meta WhatsApp Business API credentials
Per-integration boolean feature flags on tenants (integration_twilio_sms, integration_whatsapp)
Repricing of billable services in credits (e-sign 7, SMS 2, verification 31)
credit_costs (price list mapping billable category to credit cost)
OCR retired as a billable credit category
Ledger charge-category vocabulary (the CHECK constraint that gates every ledger line)
Auto-extension charges itemised as Extension Rental / Extension Tax / Extension Service Fee
ledger_entries (per-rental money ledger of charges and payments)
Test-mode credit spend isolated to test_balance
Rationale: test mode used to drain the live balance — deduct_credits ignored p_is_test_mode
New tenants auto-granted 1000 test credits at insert
'sms' credit category renamed to 'twilio' (covers WhatsApp and SMS together)
Wallet row is SELECT ... FOR UPDATE locked and lazily created on first spend
deduct_credits returns auto_refill_needed so callers can trigger a top-up
credit_transactions (append-only credit spend/purchase log)
Staff profile avatar on app_users
app_users (portal staff identity and RBAC role)
Super-admin whitelist override on the cross-tenant customer blacklist
Three-distinct-tenant blocking threshold promotes an email to the global blacklist
Rationale: blacklist entries are deliberately sticky — no longer auto-removed when the block count drops below 3
Unblocking a customer deactivates every derived identity (licence, id number, Veriff document) and refreshes the global count
Unblock writes an UNBLOCK_CUSTOMER audit_logs entry attributed to the calling app_user
unblock_customer refuses callers whose tenant differs from the customer's tenant
Rationale: the blacklist view must be DROPped, not replaced — new columns in the middle shift column positions
Blacklist review surface: email + whitelist state + the tenants that blocked it
global_blacklist (cross-tenant deny list keyed by email)
blocked_identities (per-tenant blocked licence/id/email records)
customers (renter records, per tenant)
audit_logs (actor-attributed record of privileged actions)
Installment config v2 — key rename plus per-day amount thresholds
Rationale: installment settings live in a JSONB blob, so renaming keys requires an in-place data rewrite of every tenant row plus a new column default
what_gets_split default flipped from 'rental_tax' to 'rental_only'
Per-day amount thresholds gate whether weekly/monthly installments are offered (0 = disabled)
Fine evidence photo storage bucket
fine-evidence bucket policies are not tenant-scoped: any authenticated user may read or delete any object
Fines attributed to the rental they occurred on
fines (traffic/penalty charges raised against a customer)
ON DELETE SET NULL: a fine outlives the rental it came from
Notification visibility model: own + tenant broadcast + tenant admin + super admin
Rationale: super admins carry no tenant context, so every notification policy needs an explicit is_super_admin() arm
user_id IS NULL marks a notification as a tenant-wide broadcast
notifications (portal staff notification inbox)
CMS tenant isolation replaces wide-open USING(true) policies
Anon role keeps a read-only path so the booking site can render CMS content with the public key
tenant_id IS NULL rows are platform-global CMS content readable by every tenant
Rationale: policies are dropped and re-created idempotently because the earlier CMS RLS migration may not have run on every environment
Anon SELECT on testimonials, promotions and cms_media is USING(true) — any tenant's content is readable with the public key
Server-side new-booking notification for portal staff
Rationale: the notification is a DB trigger so it fires no matter which frontend or edge function creates the rental
Original design: one notification row per active admin/head_admin/manager/ops user
rentals (booking/rental agreement lifecycle row)
vehicles (fleet inventory)
Chat message notification routing by sender_type
Two separate inboxes: notifications for staff, customer_notifications for the booking app
Message body is truncated to LEFT(content,100) in the notification preview
Customer-side notification targets only the first linked customer_users row (LIMIT 1)
customer_notifications (booking-app customer notification inbox)
chat_channel_messages (realtime chat message rows)
customer_users (auth link between auth.users and customers)
Switch from per-user fan-out to a single broadcast notification row
Rationale: per-user rows plus the new admin/super-admin RLS arms produced duplicate notifications in the inbox
Customer notification on booking approval and rejection
Notification fires only on a real status transition, gated on specific OLD -> NEW status pairs
Human-facing booking reference derived as 'R-' + first 6 chars of the rental UUID
Customers with no customer_users login are silently skipped — walk-in bookings get no in-app notice
Customer notification on ordinary cancellation (distinct from rejection)
approval_status = 'rejected' is what separates a rejection from a cancellation on the same Cancelled status
Renewal-aware booking notification (staff broadcast + customer notice)
renewed_from_rental_id is the sole discriminator between a new booking and a renewal
Per-tenant security deposit on/off toggle
Tenant-configurable customer review tags
Rationale: replaces the hardcoded positive/negative tag list baked into the review UI
review_tags (per-tenant vocabulary for rental review tagging)
review_tags has SELECT/INSERT/DELETE policies but no UPDATE policy — a tag can only be recreated, not renamed
Per-tenant required identity document type (licence / passport / id card)
Allowed document values are documented only in a COMMENT — no CHECK constraint enforces them
Per-rental mileage allowance and excess-rate overrides
NULL override means fall back to the vehicle's mileage settings
First rental charge split into per-category ledger lines from the invoice breakdown
Rationale: category-split charges are needed so the ledger matches how the portal and apply-payment already allocate money
Fallback to a single lump Rental charge when no invoice row exists
Idempotency: any existing Charge on the start date aborts, plus ON CONFLICT ux_rental_charge_unique per line
'Collection Fee' is inserted as a ledger category but is absent from the ledger_entries category CHECK list
Collection fee is read from rentals, not from the invoice breakdown
invoices (priced breakdown of a booking: rental fee, tax, service fee, deposit, insurance, delivery, extras)
